Pytest has a bigger maintainer pool, but also higher issue volume + more process/triage, so comments can sit unless you attach a CI-ready fix. If your goal is “relationship per unit effort,” I’d bias hypothesis first; for “impact surface area,” pytest can be huge but you’ll want an exceptionally concrete artifact/PR.
